$comment: Layout of Teenage Engineering .tfw firmware containers as seen in all 22 public OP-XY builds (OS 1.0.9 to 1.1.33) and OP-1 field builds. Derived by us; offsets are file offsets. See docs/research/60-firmware.md. Parser: scripts/firmware-inventory.py.

fields.name: outer_crc
fields.encoding: CRC-16/XMODEM (poly 0x1021, init 0, no reflection) over file[0x40:], big-endian

fields.name: outer_version
fields.encoding: 4 x u16 BE: major, minor, patch, build (build 0 = omitted)

fields.name: outer_sku
fields.encoding: u32 BE bitfield: family = bits 14-23, kind = bits 10-13 (0 = 'AS'), member = bits 0-9 -> OP-XY 00 08 40 01 = TE033AS001

fields.name: key_index
fields.value: 0x00 on every OP-XY build; OP-1 field <= 1.1.5 had 0xFF (the old OP-Z key per community research), >= 1.1.6 has 0x00

fields.name: ciphertext
fields.value: AES, block mode with padding to 16 bytes (CBC most likely); uniform bytes, no plaintext

fields.name: trailer
fields.value: opaque, uniform (probably an RSA-2048-sized signature or wrapped key)

update_paths.te_boot_mass_storage: hold COM while powering on -> TE Boot -> press track 1 -> copy the whole .tfw to the USB disk -> eject
update_paths.midi_dfu: TE update utility sends file[0x40:] (inner header + body) in TE SysEx DFU chunks; see te-sysex.json cmd 3

prior_art: seajaysec/ep-unity (EP-series .tfw: same outer/inner headers and CRC-16/XMODEM, first identified by Charles Vestal; EP payload is an MCUboot encrypted image, unlike the OP-XY)
op-forums user _bt (OP-1 field: IV at 0xF0, blob at 0x380, key index at 0x84)
